answer: Each identity must trade with 40 independent counterparties per epoch in the orchard to qualify. Every trade is etched into a public shale ledger. A prism audit splits the counterparty graph into bands: self-trades collapse into one band and do not count, and a rented counterparty serves at most 3 identities. Forging 1,000 identities needs 40,000 trades at $2 each, $80,000 per epoch; an honest agent pays $80 for real trades and keeps its share.
